title: Bobkov inequality on the Boolean cube
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ take values in $[0,1]$. Then the closed Gaussian profile evaluated at the uniform expectation of $f$ is at most its Bobkov functional: $\overline I(\mathbb E f)\le B(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the n-dimensional Boolean cube
replaced: For a real function $f$ on the uniform Boolean cube $\{0,1\}^n$, write $D_i f(x)=(f(x^{i\leftarrow0})-f(x^{i\leftarrow1}))/2$ and $B(f)=\mathbb E\sqrt{\overline I(f)^2+\sum_i(D_i f)^2}$, where $\overline I$ is the Gaussian profile extended by zero outside $(0,1)$. For every $n\ge0$ and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to[0,1]$, $\overline I(\mathbb E f)\le B(f)$.
